method: Finite grid framing + conservative AABB collision and visibility; not physical simulation or model inference
limitations: AABB checks are conservative; thin/angled geometry may be over-rejected.
Sampled skeleton visibility does not include self-occlusion or actual pixel text legibility.
TV visibility sampled at nine points; person overlapping TV is checked in final renders.
Dimensions and motion are existing scene estimates, not surveyed site measurements.
Camera support approximated as 24cm vertical column, not a full tripod.
Best within this finite grid and scoring function, not a continuous global optimum.
